title: Expressive range / Core

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Establish a recognizable default so routine communications have a shared visual starting point.
strategic_value: A core palette can connect Instagram campaigns despite changes in imagery and message.
demonstration: Four vertical examples use the gradient, orange and pink alongside photography and illustration.
practical_value: Start ordinary consumer marketing with the core mode before choosing a quieter or more expressive variant.

content_islands.name: Top pair
content_islands.spec: Compare a gradient commerce panel with a photographic stories panel.

content_islands.name: Bottom pair
content_islands.spec: Compare an orange tips illustration with a pink Creator Week composition.

reference_purposes.Intent: The surrounding text defines Core as the starting point for core consumer marketing.
reference_purposes.Expression: The four examples share vivid core colors while changing content.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples apply the core palette to commerce, stories, tips and an event.

ingredient.name: Core palette mode
ingredient.role: Give routine marketing a consistent color reference.
ingredient.application: Use the five core colors and core gradient described beside the examples.
ingredient.scope: The source’s core consumer-marketing mode, not a requirement to use every color in each asset.
